features.name: Apex Predator
features.text: The Apex Stalker is immune to fear effects and cannot be intimidated. It has Advantage on attacks against Frightened targets.

features.name: Rending Claws
features.text: Melee attack dealing 2d10+4 Physical damage. On hit, the target is Bleeding and must make a DC 15 Strength Reaction Roll or be knocked Prone.

features.name: Tail Sweep
features.text: Trigger: A character moves within Close range. Effect: The Stalker makes a free attack dealing 1d8+4 damage. On hit, the target's movement ends.

features.name: Thick Hide
features.text: The Apex Stalker has Resistance to Physical damage from weapons Tier 2 or below.

features.name: Territorial Rage
features.text: When reduced below half HP, the Apex Stalker gains +2 to attack rolls and deals an additional die of damage.

features.name: Rapid Adaptation
features.text: Trigger: The Biomancer takes damage. Effect: The Biomancer gains

features.name: Multi-Limb Assault
features.text: The Biomancer makes 3 attacks: Claw (2d8 Physical), Needle (1d6 + Poison), and Shock Tendril (1d8 Energy + Stun on failed DC 15 Strength Reaction Roll).

features.name: Regeneration
features.text: The Biomancer heals 5 HP at the start of every turn unless they took Fire damage in the previous round.

features.name: Consume Trait
features.text: The Biomancer grapples a target and attempts to absorb genetic material. On a successful grapple, the target takes 2d10 damage and the Biomancer gains a characteristic of their species for the rest of the combat.

features.name: Unstable Biology
features.text: When reduced to half HP or below, the Biomancer's form destabilizes. All creatures within Close range must make a DC 15 Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d6 Acid damage as the Biomancer's body sprays unstable compounds.

features.name: Fanatical Devotion
features.text: Zealots are immune to fear effects and cannot be intimidated. They fight until destroyed.

features.name: Willing Sacrifice
features.text: Trigger: An ally within Close range would be hit by an attack. Effect: The Zealot intercepts the attack, taking the damage instead.

features.name: Suicide Strike
features.text: The Zealot triggers an explosive device, dealing 3d6 damage to all targets within Close range. The Zealot is destroyed.

features.name: Massive
features.text: The Elder Leviathan ignores difficult terrain and can move through structures, destroying anything smaller than itself. Melee attacks against it from Medium or closer range provoke free attacks.

features.name: Swallow Whole
features.text: The Leviathan attempts to consume a target. DC 20 Agility Reaction Roll. Failure: The target is swallowed, taking 3d6 Acid damage at the start of each of their turns. They can attack from inside (dealing damage to the Leviathan) or attempt a DC 15 Strength check to escape.

features.name: Shield-Sense
features.text: The Leviathan automatically detects active energy shields within Far range and prioritizes attacking targets with active shields.

features.name: Quantum Surge
features.text: The Leviathan channels Veil energy through its body, creating a shockwave. All targets within Close range must make a DC 15 Agility Reaction Roll or be thrown to Far range and take 2d8 damage.

features.name: Regenerative Metabolism
features.text: The Leviathan heals 3 HP at the start of each turn while submerged in Hydros's waters. This healing stops if exposed to air for more than 1 round.

features.name: Rust Aura
features.text: Any tech item or mechanical weapon used within Close range suffers a Glitch on a Fear Die result of 1-3 (normally 1).

features.name: Acid Spray
features.text: Ranged attack (Cone, Close range). Deal 2d8+4 Acid damage. On hit, the target's armor permanently loses 1 Armor Slot effectiveness until repaired.

features.name: Unstoppable Charge
features.text: The Beast moves in a straight line up to Far range. Any character in the path must make a DC 15 Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked Prone and take 3d6 Physical damage.

features.name: Metal-Sense
features.text: The Ferro-Beast can sense refined metals within Far range. It prioritizes attacking the character wearing the most metal (heavy armor, cybernetics).

features.name: Chameleonic Skin
features.text: In dim light or darkness, Gloomfangs are invisible until they attack or take damage. Attacks against invisible Gloomfangs have Disadvantage.

features.name: Silence Aura
features.text: All sound within Close range of a Gloomfang is suppressed. Communication requires

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: Gloomfangs gain +2 to attack rolls against targets within Close range of another Gloomfang.

features.name: Throat-Ripper
features.text: The Gloomfang lunges for a vital area. On hit, deal 2d8+2 damage and the target is Silenced (cannot speak or use verbal abilities) until they receive medical attention.

features.name: Format Lance
features.text: Ranged attack that bypasses shields entirely. On hit, deal 2d6+3 Format damage. Targets reduced to 0 HP by Format damage are crystallized into perfect geometric statues.

features.name: Perfect Tracking
features.text: Wardens cannot be evaded through conventional means. Stealth checks against active Wardens have Disadvantage.

features.name: Reconstruction
features.text: If destroyed, a Warden reforms after 1 hour unless destroyed with Void damage or removed from its patrol zone.

features.name: Designation Protocol
features.text: Wardens ignore targets that are not moving and not interacting with protected systems. Perfect stillness can avoid detection.

features.name: Reality Corrosion
features.text: Technology that touches a Rust Hulk develops glitches. Any tech item used within Close range suffers a Glitch on a Fear Die result of 1-3 (normally 1).

features.name: Integrate
features.text: The Hulk grabs a piece of technology and crushes it into its body. The item is destroyed; the Hulk heals HP equal to the item's Tier × 4.

features.name: Corroded Slam
features.text: A brutal melee attack that deals 2d6+3 Physical damage. On a hit, the target's armor loses 1 Armor Slot effectiveness until repaired.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.text: The Rust Hulk ignores the first Stun or Slow effect each scene.

features.name: Repair Protocol
features.text: The drone attempts to 'fix' a target within Close range using welding lasers and manipulator arms. On hit, deal 1d6 Physical and the target is Bleeding.

features.name: Networked Response
features.text: When a Scrap Drone is destroyed, all other Scrap Drones within Far range are alerted and converge on the location.

features.name: Harmony Pulse
features.text: The Seraph attacks a target's mind. Deal 2d8+3 Neural damage and the target must make a DC 15 Presence Reaction Roll or

features.name: Mass Calm
features.text: The Seraph broadcasts its pacification signal to all targets within Close range. Each target must make a DC 15 Presence Reaction Roll or be Docile until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Reformation
features.text: When damaged, the Seraph can split into 2 Lesser Seraphs (Tier 2, HP 12 each). This can only occur once per combat.

features.name: Perfect Serenity
features.text: The Seraph is immune to all mental effects, including intimidation, fear, and Neural damage.

features.name: Compliance Protocol
features.text: Docile targets near the Seraph can be given simple commands ('stop,' 'come here,' 'drop your weapons') that they must obey.

features.name: Swarm Tactics
features.text: While the Horde has 3+ HP, it can attack two targets within Close range simultaneously.

features.name: Wire-Chewer
features.text: Trigger: A PC in Close range rolls a Failure with Fear. Effect: The swarm damages a piece of equipment, giving it the Glitchy condition until repaired.

features.name: Scatter
features.text: The swarm separates and reforms in a different location within Far range, moving through vents or floor grates to bypass blockers.

features.name: Dominate Will
features.text: Target one character within Close range. DC 15 Presence Reaction Roll. Failure: The target is Charmed and must use their next Action to attack an ally or defend the Prophet.

features.name: Void Shield
features.text: Trigger: The Prophet is hit by an attack. Effect: Spend 1 Fear. The damage is reduced to 0. The attacker takes 1d6 Stress as the Void lashes back.

features.name: Reality Tear
features.text: Ranged attack. Creates a permanent Void Zone (2m radius) on the battlefield. Entering or starting a turn in the zone deals 2d8 Void damage.

features.name: Hollow Whispers
features.text: At the start of each round, all characters within Far range hear whispers promising power, salvation, or their deepest desires. DC 15 Presence Reaction Roll or suffer Disadvantage on attacks against the Prophet until their next turn.

features.name: Destroy the Anchor
features.text: The Prophet can only be permanently killed by destroying its armor anchor. If reduced to 0 HP without destroying the armor, the Prophet reforms in 1d4 hours.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.text: All characters within Far range are pulled 20 feet toward the Witch. Characters who collide with objects take 1d8 Impact damage.

features.name: Entropic Shield
features.text: The Witch has +2 Evasion against ranged attacks as projectiles curve around them.

features.name: Life Tap
features.text: Trigger: The Witch takes damage. Effect: The Witch transfers the damage to a loyal Minion within Close range. The Minion dies instantly.

features.name: Void Bolt
features.text: Ranged attack. Deal 2d6+3 Void damage and the target must make a DC 15 Presence Reaction Roll or mark 1 Stress.

features.name: Multi-Limb
features.text: The Kraken makes 3 separate Tentacle attacks. Each attack can target a different enemy within Far range.

features.name: Reality Warping
features.text: The area within Far range of the Kraken is Difficult Terrain. Gravity changes randomly each round (d6: 1-3 Normal, 4-6 Zero-G).

features.name: Gaze of the Void
features.text: One target must make a DC 20 Presence Reaction Roll. Failure: The target is Paralyzed with fear and takes 2d6 Stress.

features.name: Phase Through
features.text: The Kraken phases partially into the Veil, becoming immune to physical damage until the start of its next turn. While phased, it can move through solid objects.

features.name: Ink Cloud
features.text: Trigger: The Kraken takes 15+ damage from a single attack. Effect: The Kraken releases a cloud of void-stuff, heavily obscuring all areas within Close range until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Swarm
features.text: Void Leeches are treated as a swarm. Area attacks deal double damage; single-target attacks deal half damage. Each 2 HP lost represents one Leech destroyed.

features.name: Energy Drain
features.text: On a successful hit, the target loses 1 Hope in addition to taking damage.

features.name: Hope-Seeker
features.text: The swarm prioritizes targets who currently hold Hope, moving toward them and ignoring other targets if possible.

features.name: Scatter
features.text: Trigger: The swarm takes 6+ damage from a single attack. Effect: The swarm disperses, reforming into two smaller swarms (half HP each) in different locations.

features.name: Life Drain
features.text: Damage dealt by Void Mites cannot be reduced by armor. Characters reduced to 0 HP by Void Mites do not die but fall into a coma lasting 1d6 days.

features.name: Emotion Sense
features.text: The cluster moves toward the character with the highest current Stress or most recently marked Hope.

features.name: Phase Scatter
features.text: Trigger: The cluster takes 4+ damage from a single attack. Effect: The cluster disperses into the Veil, reforming 1d4 rounds later in a different location within the same zone.

features.name: Ambush Predator
features.text: If the Stalker attacks from hiding, it deals an additional 2d6 damage and the target must make a DC 15 Instinct check or be Frightened until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.text: The Stalker teleports between shadows within Far range as a move action. This does not provoke reactions.

features.name: Terrifying Presence
features.text: All creatures within Close range must make a DC 15 Presence check at the start of their turn or mark 1 Stress.

features.name: Consume Fear
features.text: When a creature within Close range marks Stress, the Stalker heals 2 HP.

features.name: Unnatural Anatomy
features.text: Critical hits against the Stalker deal normal damage instead of double.

features.name: Phase Form
features.text: The Wraith-Touched exists partially in the Veil. They can move through solid objects at half speed and ignore difficult terrain.

features.name: Reality Theft
features.text: On a successful hit, the target must make a DC 15 Presence Reaction Roll or become Blurred (attacks against them have Advantage, their attacks have Disadvantage) until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Veil Step
features.text: The Wraith-Touched vanishes into the Veil, reappearing at any point within Far range on their next turn. While in the Veil, they cannot be targeted.

features.name: Desperate Anchor
features.text: Trigger: The Wraith-Touched is reduced to 2 HP or below. Effect: They grab a target within Close range, dealing 1d6 Void damage and healing the same amount.
